status: Colour Flashlight / all three original museum encounters
floor_roles: Open canopy / sky through shaft B
route_note: Four movable lamps in the west wing; white room centred over shaft A; lightwell centred over shaft B; five-switch sphere in the south bay; sixteen-cell comparison wall in the east wing. Both 5 by 6 metre shaft holes remain open inside the rooms, with continuous walkways around their sides. The white room is deeper for a route past the pink recess; the lightwell is wider for a ground-level lane beside its original ramp. Doorways connect across the central tower slab. Both rooms remain independently editable.
